headline: RBI Issues Amendment Directions on Suspected Money Mule Accounts
summary: The Reserve Bank of India issued amendment directions establishing a uniform, time-bound procedure for banks to place temporary debit holds on accounts suspected of being linked to cyber-enabled financial frauds.
why: Central bank regulatory directives directly mandate compliance and risk management procedures across the commercial banking sector.

impacts.name: Banking Sector India
impacts.why: Mandatory operational procedures for fraud detection alter compliance workflows for commercial banks.
